name: now-playing-theme
description: Tints VS Code with the colors of the album art playing on Spotify or YouTube Music (Windows).

commands.title: Now Playing Theme: Switch Background (Video / Cover / Colors)
Now Playing Theme: Restore My Original Colors
Now Playing Theme: Enable Album Art Background
Now Playing Theme: Disable Album Art Background
Now Playing Theme: Enable Music Video Background
Now Playing Theme: Disable Music Video Background

nowPlayingTheme.enabled.description: Tint VS Code with the current song's album art.

nowPlayingTheme.sources.description: Where to read the song from. 'browser' covers YouTube Music in Chrome/Edge/Firefox/Brave/Opera (note: it also picks up regular YouTube videos).

enumDescriptions: Title bar, activity bar and status bar only.
Also tints the editor, sidebar, tabs, panel and terminal backgrounds (kept dark so code stays readable).

nowPlayingTheme.video.enabled.markdownDescription: Play the song's music video (muted) behind your code. Needs the album-art background and yt-dlp - run **Enable Music Video Background** once.

enumDescriptions: Full video, synced to the song's position (~2-6 MB per song).
Tiny low-res copy looping a 30-second slice; not synced (~0.5-2 MB per song).

nowPlayingTheme.video.delaySeconds.description: Wait this long into a new song before downloading its video, so skipped songs cost nothing.

nowPlayingTheme.video.cacheMB.description: Max disk space for saved videos; least-recently-played are deleted first.

nowPlayingTheme.colors.enabled.description: Tint the title bar, status bar, etc. with the cover's colors.

nowPlayingTheme.background.enabled.markdownDescription: Show the cover art behind your code. Turn on with the **Enable Album Art Background** command (it patches VS Code's workbench.html).

enumDescriptions: Sharp cover on the right, fading into a blurred fill.

nowPlayingTheme.background.opacity.description: How strongly the cover shows through (0.1 = subtle, 0.35 = bold).

nowPlayingTheme.restoreWhenStopped.description: Put your original colors back when the music app closes.

nowPlayingTheme.minTrackSeconds.description: Ignore anything shorter than this, so YouTube ads don't change the theme. 0 = follow everything.

nowPlayingTheme.pollIntervalMs.description: How often to check what's playing.
